# PrimeQE Universal Application Standards
For all application work, read and apply `skills/primeqe-universal-web-app-excellence/SKILL.md` first. Treat its P0 items as release blockers, and decide which P1/P2 capabilities genuinely apply. Preserve existing routes, functionality, data, history, permissions, integrations and workflows. Test actual interaction states (including hover, focus, dark mode), deep links, mobile accessibility, security and regressions. Never claim a production fix, deployment, real-time sync or QA pass without verification. Report changes and blockers precisely.
